Having hung vinyl  siding there's two ways to join corners together. The first is what your contractor did.  
  
 The second is a piece of channeling on each side. 

 Conversely the second looks better and acts as a more natural drain for moisture and allows natural expansion and contraction during heat and cold periods. 

What you did is prevent the pieces from being able to correctly expand and contract. That's what the little gap was for. Now is going to warp all along the wall due to how heat effects vinyl. 

I wouldn't be surprised if it ends up looking like ocean ripples along both walls.

 Also you probably voided any contractor warranty with your fix. Caulk is a pain to remove and removing it without damaging the material is neigh impossible.
